clips.title: The story
paras: At his expedition camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale, Hemet Nesingwary challenges travelers to prove their prowess in the wilderness. The famed hunter demands ten Stranglethorn Raptors slain to test whether you possess genuine hunting talent.

Following your arrival in the jungle after Welcome to the Jungle, Hemet Nesingwary offers to test your tracking and hunting capabilities. Rather than handing out maps or directions, he insists that finding the Stranglethorn Raptors yourself is half the test, challenging you to venture out into the brush and bring down ten of the fierce beasts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So you think your hunting skills are in tip-top shape? I can put them to the test in a jiffy. Head out into that jungle and kill 10 Stranglethorn Raptors. We'll see just how much of a big game hunter you are.
And no, I won't tell you where you can find them! Locating the beasts is half the challenge.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I never met a hunter who got any kills by standing around the campfire. Were you planning on killing those Stranglethorn Raptors or were you hoping they would die of old age?
